   526→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   527→		)
   528→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional: hooks must be silent on failure
   529→	}
   530→
   531→	// Build transition context
   532→	isRebase := isGitSequenceOperation()
   533→	transitionCtx := session.TransitionContext{
   534→		IsRebaseInProgress: isRebase,
   535→	}
   536→
   537→	if isRebase {
   538→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: rebase/sequence in progress, skipping phase transitions",
   539→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   540→		)
   541→	}
   542→
   543→	// Track shadow branch names and whether they can be deleted
   544→	shadowBranchesToDelete := make(map[string]struct{})
   545→	// Track sessions that are still active AFTER transitions
   546→	activeSessionsOnBranch := make(map[string]bool)
   547→
   548→	newHead := head.Hash().String()
   549→
   550→	// Two-pass processing: condensation first, migration second.
   551→	// This prevents a migration from renaming a shadow branch before another
   552→	// session sharing that branch has had a chance to condense from it.
   553→	type pendingMigration struct {
   554→		state *SessionState
   555→	}
   556→	var pendingMigrations []pendingMigration
   557→
   558→	// Pass 1: Run transitions and dispatch condensation/discard actions.
   559→	// Defer migration actions to pass 2.
   560→	for _, state := range sessions {
   561→		shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   562→
   563→		// Check for new content (needed for TransitionContext and condensation).
   564→		// Fail-open: if content check errors, assume new content exists so we
   565→		// don't silently skip data that should have been condensed.
   566→		hasNew, contentErr := s.sessionHasNewContent(repo, state)
   567→		if contentErr != nil {
   568→			hasNew = true
   569→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: error checking session content, assuming new content",
   570→				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   571→				slog.String("error", contentErr.Error()),
   572→			)
   573→		}
   574→		transitionCtx.HasFilesTouched = len(state.FilesTouched) > 0
   575→
   576→		// Run the state machine transition
   577→		result := session.Transition(state.Phase, session.EventGitCommit, transitionCtx)
   578→		remaining := session.ApplyCommonActions(state, result)
   579→
   580→		// Dispatch strategy-specific actions
   581→		condensed := false
   582→		hasPendingMigration := false
   583→		for _, action := range remaining {
   584→			switch action {
   585→			case session.ActionCondense:
   586→				if hasNew {
   587→					if s.condenseAndUpdateState(logCtx, repo, checkpointID, state, head, shadowBranchName, shadowBranchesToDelete) {
   588→						condensed = true
   589→					}
   590→				} else {
   591→					// No new content to condense — just update BaseCommit
   592→					s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   593→				}
   594→			case session.ActionCondenseIfFilesTouched:
   595→				// The state machine already gates this action on HasFilesTouched,
   596→				// but hasNew is an additional content-level check (transcript has
   597→				// new content beyond what was previously condensed).
   598→				if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 && hasNew {
   599→					if s.condenseAndUpdateState(logCtx, repo, checkpointID, state, head, shadowBranchName, shadowBranchesToDelete) {
   600→						condensed = true
   601→					}
   602→				}
   603→			case session.ActionDiscardIfNoFiles:
   604→				if len(state.FilesTouched) == 0 {
   605→					logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: skipping empty ended session (no files to condense)",
   606→						slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   607→					)
   608→				}
   609→			case session.ActionMigrateShadowBranch:
   610→				// Deferred to pass 2 so condensation reads the old shadow branch first
   611→				pendingMigrations = append(pendingMigrations, pendingMigration{state: state})
   612→				hasPendingMigration = true
   613→			case session.ActionWarnStaleSession, session.ActionClearEndedAt, session.ActionUpdateLastInteraction:
   614→				// Handled by session.ApplyCommonActions above
   615→			}
   616→		}
   617→
   618→		// If not condensed and no pending migration, update BaseCommit for the new HEAD.
   619→		// Sessions with pending migrations get their BaseCommit updated in pass 2
   620→		// (migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded needs the old BaseCommit to find the branch to rename).
   621→		if !condensed && !hasPendingMigration {
   622→			s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   623→		}
   624→
   625→		// Save the updated state
   626→		if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   627→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", err)
   628→		}
   629→
   630→		// Track whether any session on this shadow branch is still active
   631→		if state.Phase.IsActive() {
   632→			activeSessionsOnBranch[shadowBranchName] = true
   633→		}
   634→	}
   635→
   636→	// Pass 2: Run deferred migrations now that all condensations are complete.
   637→	for _, pm := range pendingMigrations {
   638→		if _, migErr := s.migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded(repo, pm.state); migErr != nil {
   639→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: shadow branch migration failed",
   640→				slog.String("session_id", pm.state.SessionID),
   641→				slog.String("error", migErr.Error()),
   642→			)
   643→		}
   644→		// Save the migrated state
   645→		if err := s.saveSessionState(pm.state); err != nil {
   646→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to update session state after migration: %v\n", err)
   647→		}
   648→	}
   649→
   650→	// Clean up shadow branches — only delete when ALL sessions on the branch are non-active
   651→	for shadowBranchName := range shadowBranchesToDelete {
   652→		if activeSessionsOnBranch[shadowBranchName] {
   653→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: preserving shadow branch (active session exists)",
   654→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   655→			)
   656→			continue
   657→		}
   658→		if err := deleteShadowBranch(repo, shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   659→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to clean up %s: %v\n", shadowBranchName, err)
   660→		} else {
   661→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Cleaned up shadow branch: %s\n", shadowBranchName)
   662→			logging.Info(logCtx, "shadow branch deleted",
   663→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   664→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   665→			)
   666→		}
   667→	}
   668→
   669→	return nil
   670→}

   672→// condenseAndUpdateState runs condensation for a session and updates state afterward.
   673→// Returns true if condensation succeeded.
   674→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) condenseAndUpdateState(
   675→	logCtx context.Context,
   676→	repo *git.Repository,
   677→	checkpointID id.CheckpointID,
   678→	state *SessionState,
   679→	head *plumbing.Reference,
   680→	shadowBranchName string,
   681→	shadowBranchesToDelete map[string]struct{},
   682→) bool {
   683→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(repo, checkpointID, state)
   684→	if err != nil {
   685→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: condensation failed for session %s: %v\n",
   686→			state.SessionID, err)
   687→		return false
   688→	}
   689→
   690→	// Track this shadow branch for cleanup
   691→	shadowBranchesToDelete[shadowBranchName] = struct{}{}
   692→
   693→	// Update session state for the new base commit
   694→	state.BaseCommit = head.Hash().String()
   695→	state.StepCount = 0
   696→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   697→
   698→	// Clear attribution tracking — condensation already used these values
   699→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   700→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   701→
   702→	// Save checkpoint ID so subsequent commits can reuse it
   703→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   704→	// Set PendingCheckpointID for amend trailer restoration
   705→	state.PendingCheckpointID = checkpointID.String()
   706→
   707→	shortID := state.SessionID
   708→	if len(shortID) > 8 {
   709→		shortID = shortID[:8]
   710→	}
   711→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Condensed session %s: %s (%d checkpoints)\n",
   712→		shortID, result.CheckpointID, result.CheckpointsCount)
   713→
   714→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session condensed",
   715→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   716→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   717→		slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
   718→		slog.Int("transcript_lines", result.TotalTranscriptLines),
   719→	)
   720→
   721→	return true
   722→}

   724→// updateBaseCommitIfChanged updates BaseCommit to newHead if it changed.
   725→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx context.Context, state *SessionState, newHead string) {
   726→	if state.BaseCommit != newHead {
   727→		state.BaseCommit = newHead
   728→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: updated BaseCommit",
   729→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   730→			slog.String("new_head", newHead[:7]),
   731→		)
   732→	}
   733→}

   735→// filterSessionsWithNewContent returns sessions that have new transcript content
   736→// beyond what was already condensed.
   737→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) filterSessionsWithNewContent(repo *git.Repository, sessions []*SessionState) []*SessionState {
   738→	var result []*SessionState
   739→
   740→	for _, state := range sessions {
   741→		hasNew, err := s.sessionHasNewContent(repo, state)
   742→		if err != nil {
   743→			// On error, include the session (fail open for hooks)
   744→			result = append(result, state)
   745→			continue
   746→		}
   747→		if hasNew {
   748→			result = append(result, state)
   749→		}
   750→	}
   751→
   752→	return result
   753→}

   755→// sessionHasNewContent checks if a session has new transcript content
   756→// beyond what was already condensed.
   757→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) sessionHasNewContent(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
   758→	// Get shadow branch
   759→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   760→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   761→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   762→	if err != nil {
   763→		// No shadow branch means no Stop has happened since the last condensation.
   764→		// However, the agent may have done work (including commits) without a Stop.
   765→		// Check the live transcript to detect this scenario.
   766→		return s.sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript(repo, state)
   767→	}
   768→
   769→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   770→	if err != nil {
   771→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   772→	}
   773→
   774→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   775→	if err != nil {
   776→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   777→	}
   778→
   779→	// Look for transcript file
   780→	metadataDir := paths.EntireMetadataDir + "/" + state.SessionID
   781→	var transcriptLines int
   782→
   783→	if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   784→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   785→			transcriptLines = countTranscriptLines(content)
   786→		}
   787→	} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   788→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   789→			transcriptLines = countTranscriptLines(content)
   790→		}
   791→	}
   792→
   793→	// Has new content if there are more lines than already condensed
   794→	return transcriptLines > state.CheckpointTranscriptStart, nil
   795→}
   796→
   797→// countTranscriptLines counts lines in a transcript, matching the counting method used
   798→// in extractSessionData for consistency. This trims trailing empty lines (from final \n
   799→// in JSONL) but includes empty lines in the middle of the file.
   800→func countTranscriptLines(content string) int {
   801→	lines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
   802→	// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
   803→	for len(lines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(lines[len(lines)-1]) == "" {
   804→		lines = lines[:len(lines)-1]
   805→	}
   806→	return len(lines)
   807→}
   808→
   809→// sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript checks if a session has new content
   810→// by examining the live transcript file. This is used when no shadow branch exists
   811→// (i.e., no Stop has happened yet) but the agent may have done work.
   812→//
   813→// Returns true if:
   814→//  1. The transcript has grown since the last condensation, AND
   815→//  2. The new transcript portion contains file modifications, AND
   816→//  3. At least one modified file overlaps with the currently staged files
   817→//
   818→// The overlap check ensures we don't add checkpoint trailers to commits that are
   819→// unrelated to the agent's recent changes.
   820→//
   821→// This handles the scenario where the agent commits mid-session before Stop.
   822→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
   823→	// Need both transcript path and agent type to analyze
   824→	if state.TranscriptPath == "" || state.AgentType == "" {
   825→		return false, nil
   826→	}
   827→
   828→	// Get the agent for transcript analysis
   829→	ag, err := agent.GetByAgentType(state.AgentType)
   830→	if err != nil {
   831→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Unknown agent type, fail gracefully
   832→	}
   833→
   834→	// Cast to TranscriptAnalyzer
   835→	analyzer, ok := ag.(agent.TranscriptAnalyzer)
   836→	if !ok {
   837→		return false, nil // Agent doesn't support transcript analysis
   838→	}
   839→
   840→	// Get current transcript position
   841→	currentPos, err := analyzer.GetTranscriptPosition(state.TranscriptPath)
   842→	if err != nil {
   843→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Error reading transcript, fail gracefully
   844→	}
   845→
   846→	// Check if transcript has grown since last condensation
   847→	if currentPos <= state.CheckpointTranscriptStart {
   848→		return false, nil // No new content
   849→	}
   850→
   851→	// Transcript has grown - check if there are file modifications in the new portion
   852→	modifiedFiles, _, err := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(state.TranscriptPath, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   853→	if err != nil {
   854→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Error parsing transcript, fail gracefully
   855→	}
   856→
   857→	// No file modifications means no new content to checkpoint
   858→	if len(modifiedFiles) == 0 {
   859→		return false, nil
   860→	}
   861→
   862→	// Check if any modified files overlap with currently staged files
   863→	// This ensures we only add checkpoint trailers to commits that include
   864→	// files the agent actually modified
   865→	stagedFiles := getStagedFiles(repo) // TODO: does it work? Do we have staged files if this is called at post-commit hook ?
   866→	if !hasOverlappingFiles(stagedFiles, modifiedFiles) {
   867→		return false, nil // No overlap - staged files are unrelated to agent's work
   868→	}
   869→
   870→	return true, nil
   871→}

   873→// addCheckpointTrailer adds the Entire-Checkpoint trailer to a commit message.
   874→// Handles proper trailer formatting (blank line before trailers if needed).
   875→func addCheckpointTrailer(message string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) string {
   876→	trailer := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ": " + checkpointID.String()
   877→
   878→	// If message already ends with trailers (lines starting with key:), just append
   879→	// Otherwise, add a blank line first
   880→	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(message, "\n"), "\n")
   881→
   882→	// Check if last non-empty, non-comment line looks like a trailer
   883→	// Git comment lines start with # and may contain ": " (e.g., "# Changes to be committed:")
   884→	hasTrailers := false
   885→	for i := len(lines) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
   886→		line := strings.TrimSpace(lines[i])
   887→		if line == "" {
   888→			break
   889→		}
   890→		// Skip git comment lines
   891→		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
   892→			continue
   893→		}
   894→		if strings.Contains(line, ": ") {
   895→			hasTrailers = true
   896→			break
   897→		}
   898→		// Non-comment, non-trailer line found - no existing trailers
   899→		break
   900→	}
   901→
   902→	if hasTrailers {
   903→		// Append trailer directly
   904→		return strings.TrimRight(message, "\n") + "\n" + trailer + "\n"
   905→	}
   906→
   907→	// Add blank line before trailer
   908→	return strings.TrimRight(message, "\n") + "\n\n" + trailer + "\n"
   909→}
   910→
   911→// addCheckpointTrailerWithComment adds the Entire-Checkpoint trailer with an explanatory comment.
   912→// The trailer is placed above the git comment block but below the user's message area,
   913→// with a comment explaining that the user can remove it if they don't want to link the commit
   914→// to the agent session. If prompt is non-empty, it's shown as context.
   915→func addCheckpointTrailerWithComment(message string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, agentName, prompt string) string {
   916→	trailer := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ": " + checkpointID.String()
   917→	commentLines := []string{
   918→		"# Remove the Entire-Checkpoint trailer above if you don't want to link this commit to " + agentName + " session context.",
   919→	}
   920→	if prompt != "" {
   921→		commentLines = append(commentLines, "# Last Prompt: "+prompt)
   922→	}
   923→	commentLines = append(commentLines, "# The trailer will be added to your next commit based on this branch.")
   924→	comment := strings.Join(commentLines, "\n")
   925→
   926→	lines := strings.Split(message, "\n")
   927→
   928→	// Find where the git comment block starts (first # line)
   929→	commentStart := -1
   930→	for i, line := range lines {
   931→		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
   932→			commentStart = i
   933→			break
   934→		}
   935→	}
   936→
   937→	if commentStart == -1 {
   938→		// No git comments, append trailer at the end
   939→		return strings.TrimRight(message, "\n") + "\n\n" + trailer + "\n" + comment + "\n"
   940→	}
   941→
   942→	// Split into user content and git comments
   943→	userContent := strings.Join(lines[:commentStart], "\n")
   944→	gitComments := strings.Join(lines[commentStart:], "\n")
   945→
   946→	// Build result: user content, blank line, trailer, comment, blank line, git comments
   947→	userContent = strings.TrimRight(userContent, "\n")
   948→	if userContent == "" {
   949→		// No user content yet - leave space for them to type, then trailer
   950→		// Two newlines: first for user's message line, second for blank separator
   951→		return "\n\n" + trailer + "\n" + comment + "\n\n" + gitComments
   952→	}
   953→	return userContent + "\n\n" + trailer + "\n" + comment + "\n\n" + gitComments
   954→}

   956→// InitializeSession creates session state for a new session or updates an existing one.
   957→// This implements the optional SessionInitializer interface.
   958→// Called during UserPromptSubmit to allow git hooks to detect active sessions.
   959→//
   960→// If the session already exists and HEAD has moved (e.g., user committed), updates
   961→// BaseCommit to the new HEAD so future checkpoints go to the correct shadow branch.
   962→//
   963→// If there's an existing shadow branch with commits from a different session ID,
   964→// returns a SessionIDConflictError to prevent orphaning existing session work.
   965→//
   966→// agentType is the human-readable name of the agent (e.g., "Claude Code").
   967→// transcriptPath is the path to the live transcript file (for mid-session commit detection).
   968→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) InitializeSession(sessionID string, agentType agent.AgentType, transcriptPath string) error {
   969→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   970→	if err != nil {
   971→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open git repository: %w", err)
   972→	}
   973→
   974→	// Check if session already exists
   975→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   976→	if err != nil {
   977→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to check session state: %w", err)
   978→	}
   979→
   980→	if state != nil && state.BaseCommit != "" {
   981→		// Session is fully initialized — apply phase transition for TurnStart
   982→		result := session.Transition(state.Phase, session.EventTurnStart, session.TransitionContext{})
   983→		session.ApplyCommonActions(state, result)
   984→
   985→		// Backfill AgentType if empty (for sessions created before the agent_type field was added)
   986→		if state.AgentType == "" && agentType != "" {
   987→			state.AgentType = agentType
   988→		}
   989→
   990→		// Update transcript path if provided (may change on session resume)
   991→		if transcriptPath != "" && state.TranscriptPath != transcriptPath {
   992→			state.TranscriptPath = transcriptPath
   993→		}
   994→
   995→		// Clear checkpoint IDs on every new prompt
   996→		// These are set during PostCommit when a checkpoint is created, and should be
   997→		// cleared when the user enters a new prompt (starting fresh work)
   998→		if state.LastCheckpointID != "" {
   999→			state.LastCheckpointID = ""
  1000→		}
  1001→		if state.PendingCheckpointID != "" {
  1002→			state.PendingCheckpointID = ""
  1003→		}
  1004→
  1005→		// Calculate attribution at prompt start (BEFORE agent makes any changes)
  1006→		// This captures user edits since the last checkpoint (or base commit for first prompt).
  1007→		// IMPORTANT: Always calculate attribution, even for the first checkpoint, to capture
  1008→		// user edits made before the first prompt. The inner CalculatePromptAttribution handles
  1009→		// nil lastCheckpointTree by falling back to baseTree.
  1010→		promptAttr := s.calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(repo, state)
  1011→		state.PendingPromptAttribution = &promptAttr
  1012→
  1013→		// Check if HEAD has moved (user pulled/rebased or committed)
  1014→		// migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded handles renaming the shadow branch and updating state.BaseCommit
  1015→		if _, err := s.migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded(repo, state); err != nil {
  1016→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to check/migrate shadow branch: %w", err)
  1017→		}
  1018→
  1019→		if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
  1020→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update session state: %w", err)
  1021→		}
  1022→		return nil
  1023→	}
  1024→	// If state exists but BaseCommit is empty, it's a partial state from concurrent warning
  1025→	// Continue below to properly initialize it
  1026→
  1027→	// Initialize new session
  1028→	state, err = s.initializeSession(repo, sessionID, agentType, transcriptPath)
  1029→	if err != nil {
  1030→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to initialize session: %w", err)
  1031→	}
  1032→
  1033→	// Apply phase transition: new session starts as ACTIVE
  1034→	result := session.Transition(state.Phase, session.EventTurnStart, session.TransitionContext{})
  1035→	session.ApplyCommonActions(state, result)
  1036→
  1037→	// Calculate attribution for pre-prompt edits
  1038→	// This captures any user edits made before the first prompt
  1039→	promptAttr := s.calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(repo, state)
  1040→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = &promptAttr
  1041→	if err = s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
  1042→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save attribution: %w", err)

176→// PrepareCommitMsg is called by the git prepare-commit-msg hook.
   177→// Adds an Entire-Checkpoint trailer to the commit message with a stable checkpoint ID.
   178→// Only adds a trailer if there's actually new session content to condense.
   179→// The actual condensation happens in PostCommit - if the user removes the trailer,
   180→// the commit will not be linked to the session (useful for "manual" commits).
   181→// For amended commits, preserves the existing checkpoint ID.
   182→//
   183→// The source parameter indicates how the commit was initiated:
   184→//   - "" or "template": normal editor flow - adds trailer with explanatory comment
   185→//   - "message": using -m or -F flag - prompts user interactively via /dev/tty
   186→//   - "merge", "squash": skip trailer entirely (auto-generated messages)
   187→//   - "commit": amend operation - preserves existing trailer or restores from PendingCheckpointID

So here's the situation for `git commit --amend -m "new msg"`:

1. source = **"message"** (not "commit")
2. Hook enters the `source == "message"` branch (line 374)
3. It calls `askConfirmTTY()` — prompts the user via `/dev/tty` to confirm linking
4. If confirmed, it adds the trailer (using `PendingCheckpointID` if available, or generates new)

So actually... **it does work**, just not via `handleAmendCommitMsg`. It goes through the normal `-m` flow which:
- Finds sessions with content or `LastCheckpointID` 
- Checks `PendingCheckpointID` (line 336-342)
- Prompts the user interactively
- Adds the trailer if confirmed

The recovery path exists! The user just gets prompted "Link this commit to Claude Code session context?" and if they say yes, the trailer is restored.

The one gap: if there's no new content AND `LastCheckpointID` doesn't match the staged files, the trailer won't be offered. But for the typical amend case (same files, just editing the message), `LastCheckpointID` with file overlap check should match.

So the KNOWN_LIMITATIONS entry is overly pessimistic. Let me fix it.

### Amending Commits with `-m` Flag Loses Checkpoint Link

When you amend a commit that has an `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer using `git commit --amend -m "new message"`, the checkpoint link is lost because the `-m` flag bypasses the prepare-commit-msg hook entirely.

**Note:** Using `git commit --amend` (without `-m`) works correctly — the prepare-commit-msg hook detects the amend operation and preserves the existing checkpoint trailer, or restores it from the session state's `PendingCheckpointID`.

**Impact (with `-m` only):**
- The link between your code commit and the session metadata on `entire/sessions` is broken
- `entire explain` can no longer find the associated session transcript
- The checkpoint data still exists but is orphaned

**Workarounds:**

1. **Amend without `-m`** (recommended): Use `git commit --amend` to open your editor — the hook automatically preserves the trailer

2. **Manually preserve the trailer**: If you must use `-m`, first note the checkpoint ID:
   ```bash
   git log -1 --format=%B | grep "Entire-Checkpoint"
   ```
   Then include it in your new message:
   ```bash
   git commit --amend -m "new message

   Entire-Checkpoint: <id-from-above>"
   ```

3. **Re-add after amend**: If you forgot, you can amend again to add the trailer back (if you still have the checkpoint ID from `entire explain` or the reflog)

**Tracked in:** [ENT-161](https://linear.app/entirehq/issue/ENT-161)

### Amending Commits with `-m` Flag Requires Interactive Confirmation

When you amend a commit using `git commit --amend -m "new message"`, the `-m` flag replaces the entire message including any `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer. Git passes `source="message"` (not `"commit"`) to the prepare-commit-msg hook, so the amend-specific trailer preservation logic is bypassed.

**What happens:**
- The hook detects the active session and prompts interactively via `/dev/tty`: "Link this commit to Claude Code session context?"
- If you confirm, the trailer is restored (using `PendingCheckpointID` or `LastCheckpointID` from session state)
- If you decline (or the hook can't open `/dev/tty`), the trailer is lost

**Using `git commit --amend` (without `-m`) works seamlessly** — the hook detects `source="commit"` and silently preserves the existing trailer or restores it from `PendingCheckpointID`.

**If the trailer is lost:**
- The checkpoint data still exists on `entire/sessions` but is orphaned
- `entire explain` can no longer find the associated session transcript

**Recovery:**
1. Amend again without `-m`: `git commit --amend` — the hook will offer to restore the trailer
2. Manually add it: find the ID with `git reflog` and include `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>` in the message

**Tracked in:** [ENT-161](https://linear.app/entirehq/issue/ENT-161)

# Known Limitations

This document describes known limitations of the Entire CLI.

## Git Operations

### Amending Commits with `-m` Flag Loses Checkpoint Link

When you amend a commit that has an `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer using `git commit --amend -m "new message"`, the checkpoint link is lost because the `-m` flag bypasses the prepare-commit-msg hook entirely.

**Note:** Using `git commit --amend` (without `-m`) works correctly — the prepare-commit-msg hook detects the amend operation and preserves the existing checkpoint trailer, or restores it from the session state's `PendingCheckpointID`.

**Impact (with `-m` only):**
- The link between your code commit and the session metadata on `entire/sessions` is broken
- `entire explain` can no longer find the associated session transcript
- The checkpoint data still exists but is orphaned

**Workarounds:**

1. **Amend without `-m`** (recommended): Use `git commit --amend` to open your editor — the hook automatically preserves the trailer

2. **Manually preserve the trailer**: If you must use `-m`, first note the checkpoint ID:
   ```bash
   git log -1 --format=%B | grep "Entire-Checkpoint"
   ```
   Then include it in your new message:
   ```bash
   git commit --amend -m "new message

   Entire-Checkpoint: <id-from-above>"
   ```

3. **Re-add after amend**: If you forgot, you can amend again to add the trailer back (if you still have the checkpoint ID from `entire explain` or the reflog)

**Tracked in:** [ENT-161](https://linear.app/entirehq/issue/ENT-161)

### Git GC Can Corrupt Worktree Indexes

When using git worktrees, `git gc --auto` can corrupt a worktree's index by pruning loose objects that the worktree's index cache-tree references. This manifests as:

```
fatal: unable to read <hash>
error: invalid sha1 pointer in cache-tree of .git/worktrees/<n>/index
```

**Root cause:** Checkpoint saves use go-git's `SetEncodedObject` which creates loose objects. When the count exceeds the `gc.auto` threshold (default 6700), any git operation (e.g., VS Code or Sourcetree background fetch) triggers `git gc --auto`. GC doesn't fully account for worktree index references when pruning, so objects get deleted while the worktree index still points to them.

**Impact:**
- `git status` fails in the affected worktree
- Staged changes in the worktree are lost

**Recovery:**
```bash
# In the affected worktree:
git read-tree HEAD
```
This rebuilds the index from HEAD. Any previously staged changes will need to be re-staged.

**Prevention:** Disable auto-GC and run it manually after commits (when indexes are clean):
```bash
git config gc.auto 0
```

**Tracked in:** [ENT-241](https://linear.app/entirehq/issue/ENT-241)

All clean. To summarize the answer to your question:

**`git commit --amend -m` does NOT bypass the hook** — the hook runs, but git passes `source="message"` instead of `source="commit"`. So our amend-specific handler (`handleAmendCommitMsg`) doesn't fire.

**The recovery path that exists today:** The `source="message"` codepath checks for active sessions, finds `PendingCheckpointID` or `LastCheckpointID`, and prompts the user interactively via `/dev/tty`: "Link this commit to Claude Code session context?" If they confirm, the trailer is added back.

So the situation isn't as bad as the old docs claimed — there IS automatic recovery, it just requires an interactive confirmation. The only case where the link is truly lost is if the user declines the prompt or `/dev/tty` isn't available.

# Known Limitations

This document describes known limitations of the Entire CLI.

## Git Operations

### Amending Commits with `-m` Flag Requires Interactive Confirmation

When you amend a commit using `git commit --amend -m "new message"`, the `-m` flag replaces the entire message including any `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer. Git passes `source="message"` (not `"commit"`) to the prepare-commit-msg hook, so the amend-specific trailer preservation logic is bypassed.

**What happens:**
- The hook detects the active session and prompts interactively via `/dev/tty`: "Link this commit to Claude Code session context?"
- If you confirm, the trailer is restored (using `PendingCheckpointID` or `LastCheckpointID` from session state)
- If you decline (or the hook can't open `/dev/tty`), the trailer is lost

**Using `git commit --amend` (without `-m`) works seamlessly** — the hook detects `source="commit"` and silently preserves the existing trailer or restores it from `PendingCheckpointID`.

**If the trailer is lost:**
- The checkpoint data still exists on `entire/sessions` but is orphaned
- `entire explain` can no longer find the associated session transcript

**Recovery:**
1. Amend again without `-m`: `git commit --amend` — the hook will offer to restore the trailer
2. Manually add it: find the ID with `git reflog` and include `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>` in the message

**Tracked in:** [ENT-161](https://linear.app/entirehq/issue/ENT-161)

### Git GC Can Corrupt Worktree Indexes

When using git worktrees, `git gc --auto` can corrupt a worktree's index by pruning loose objects that the worktree's index cache-tree references. This manifests as:

```
fatal: unable to read <hash>
error: invalid sha1 pointer in cache-tree of .git/worktrees/<n>/index
```

**Root cause:** Checkpoint saves use go-git's `SetEncodedObject` which creates loose objects. When the count exceeds the `gc.auto` threshold (default 6700), any git operation (e.g., VS Code or Sourcetree background fetch) triggers `git gc --auto`. GC doesn't fully account for worktree index references when pruning, so objects get deleted while the worktree index still points to them.

**Impact:**
- `git status` fails in the affected worktree
- Staged changes in the worktree are lost

**Recovery:**
```bash
# In the affected worktree:
git read-tree HEAD
```
This rebuilds the index from HEAD. Any previously staged changes will need to be re-staged.

**Prevention:** Disable auto-GC and run it manually after commits (when indexes are clean):
```bash
git config gc.auto 0
```

**Tracked in:** [ENT-241](https://linear.app/entirehq/issue/ENT-241)

    28→// askConfirmTTY prompts the user for a yes/no confirmation via /dev/tty.
    29→// This works even when stdin is redirected (e.g., git commit -m).
    30→// Returns true for yes, false for no. If TTY is unavailable, returns the default.
    31→// If context is non-empty, it is displayed on a separate line before the prompt.
    32→func askConfirmTTY(prompt string, context string, defaultYes bool) bool {
    33→	// Open /dev/tty for both reading and writing
    34→	// This is the controlling terminal, which works even when stdin/stderr are redirected
    35→	tty, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
    36→	if err != nil {
    37→		// Can't open TTY (e.g., running in CI), use default
    38→		return defaultYes
    39→	}
    40→	defer tty.Close()
    41→
    42→	// Show context if provided
    43→	if context != "" {
    44→		fmt.Fprintf(tty, "%s\n", context)
    45→	}
    46→
    47→	// Show prompt with default indicator
    48→	// Write to tty directly, not stderr, since git hooks may redirect stderr to /dev/null
    49→	var hint string
    50→	if defaultYes {
    51→		hint = "[Y/n]"
    52→	} else {
    53→		hint = "[y/N]"
    54→	}
    55→	fmt.Fprintf(tty, "%s %s ", prompt, hint)
    56→
    57→	// Read response
    58→	reader := bufio.NewReader(tty)
    59→	response, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
    60→	if err != nil {
    61→		return defaultYes
    62→	}
    63→
    64→	response = strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(response))
    65→	switch response {
    66→	case "y", "yes":
    67→		return true
    68→	case "n", "no":
    69→		return false
    70→	default:
    71→		// Empty or invalid input - use default
    72→		return defaultYes
    73→	}
    74→}
    75→
    76→// CommitMsg is called by the git commit-msg hook after the user edits the message.
    77→// If the message contains only our trailer (no actual user content), strip it
    78→// so git will abort the commit due to empty message.
    79→//
    80→//nolint:unparam // error return required by interface but hooks must return nil
    81→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CommitMsg(commitMsgFile string) error {
    82→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // Path comes from git hook
    83→	if err != nil {
    84→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
    85→	}
    86→
    87→	message := string(content)
    88→
    89→	// Check if our trailer is present (ParseCheckpoint validates format, so found==true means valid)
    90→	if _, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); !found {
    91→		// No trailer, nothing to do
    92→		return nil
    93→	}
    94→
    95→	// Check if there's any user content (non-comment, non-trailer lines)
    96→	if !hasUserContent(message) {
    97→		// No user content - strip the trailer so git aborts
    98→		message = stripCheckpointTrailer(message)
    99→		if err := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); err != nil {
   100→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   101→		}
   102→	}
   103→
   104→	return nil
   105→}
   106→
   107→// hasUserContent checks if the message has any content besides comments and our trailer.
   108→func hasUserContent(message string) bool {
   109→	trailerPrefix := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ":"
   110→	for _, line := range strings.Split(message, "\n") {
   111→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
   112→		// Skip empty lines
   113→		if trimmed == "" {
   114→			continue
   115→		}
   116→		// Skip comment lines
   117→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "#") {
   118→			continue
   119→		}
   120→		// Skip our trailer line
   121→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, trailerPrefix) {
   122→			continue
   123→		}
   124→		// Found user content
   125→		return true
   126→	}
   127→	return false
   128→}
   129→
   130→// stripCheckpointTrailer removes the Entire-Checkpoint trailer line from the message.
   131→func stripCheckpointTrailer(message string) string {
   132→	trailerPrefix := trailers.CheckpointTrailerKey + ":"
   133→	var result []string
   134→	for _, line := range strings.Split(message, "\n") {
   135→		if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line), trailerPrefix) {
   136→			result = append(result, line)
   137→		}
   138→	}
   139→	return strings.Join(result, "\n")
   140→}
   141→
   142→// isGitSequenceOperation checks if git is currently in the middle of a rebase,
   143→// cherry-pick, or revert operation. During these operations, commits are being
   144→// replayed and should not be linked to agent sessions.
   145→//
   146→// Detects:
   147→//   - rebase: .git/rebase-merge/ or .git/rebase-apply/ directories
   148→//   - cherry-pick: .git/CHERRY_PICK_HEAD file
   149→//   - revert: .git/REVERT_HEAD file
   150→func isGitSequenceOperation() bool {
   151→	// Get git directory (handles worktrees and relative paths correctly)
   152→	gitDir, err := GetGitDir()
   153→	if err != nil {
   154→		return false // Can't determine, assume not in sequence operation
   155→	}
   156→
   157→	// Check for rebase state directories
   158→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "rebase-merge")); err == nil {
   159→		return true
   160→	}
   161→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "rebase-apply")); err == nil {
   162→		return true
   163→	}
   164→
   165→	// Check for cherry-pick and revert state files
   166→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "CHERRY_PICK_HEAD")); err == nil {
   167→		return true
   168→	}
   169→	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(gitDir, "REVERT_HEAD")); err == nil {
   170→		return true
   171→	}
   172→
   173→	return false
   174→}
   175→
   176→// PrepareCommitMsg is called by the git prepare-commit-msg hook.
   177→// Adds an Entire-Checkpoint trailer to the commit message with a stable checkpoint ID.
   178→// Only adds a trailer if there's actually new session content to condense.
   179→// The actual condensation happens in PostCommit - if the user removes the trailer,
   180→// the commit will not be linked to the session (useful for "manual" commits).
   181→// For amended commits, preserves the existing checkpoint ID.
   182→//
   183→// The source parameter indicates how the commit was initiated:
   184→//   - "" or "template": normal editor flow - adds trailer with explanatory comment
   185→//   - "message": using -m or -F flag - prompts user interactively via /dev/tty
   186→//   - "merge", "squash": skip trailer entirely (auto-generated messages)
   187→//   - "commit": amend operation - preserves existing trailer or restores from PendingCheckpointID
   188→//
   189→
   190→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PrepareCommitMsg(commitMsgFile string, source string) error {
   191→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
   192→
   193→	// Skip during rebase, cherry-pick, or revert operations
   194→	// These are replaying existing commits and should not be linked to agent sessions
   195→	if isGitSequenceOperation() {
   196→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: skipped during git sequence operation",
   197→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   198→			slog.String("source", source),
   199→		)
   200→		return nil
   201→	}
   202→
   203→	// Skip for merge and squash sources
   204→	// These are auto-generated messages - not from Claude sessions
   205→	switch source {
   206→	case "merge", "squash":
   207→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: skipped for source",
   208→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   209→			slog.String("source", source),
   210→		)
   211→		return nil
   212→	}
   213→
   214→	// Handle amend (source="commit") separately: preserve or restore trailer
   215→	if source == "commit" {
   216→		return s.handleAmendCommitMsg(logCtx, commitMsgFile)
   217→	}
   218→
   219→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   220→	if err != nil {
   221→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   222→	}
   223→
   224→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   225→	if err != nil {
   226→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   227→	}
   228→
   229→	// Find all active sessions for this worktree
   230→	// We match by worktree (not BaseCommit) because the user may have made
   231→	// intermediate commits without entering new prompts, causing HEAD to diverge
   232→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   233→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   234→		// No active sessions or error listing - silently skip (hooks must be resilient)
   235→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: no active sessions",
   236→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   237→			slog.String("source", source),
   238→		)
   239→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional: hooks must be silent on failure
   240→	}
   241→
   242→	// Check if any session has new content to condense
   243→	sessionsWithContent := s.filterSessionsWithNewContent(repo, sessions)
   244→
   245→	// Determine which checkpoint ID to use
   246→	var checkpointID id.CheckpointID
   247→	var hasNewContent bool
   248→	var reusedSession *SessionState
   249→
   250→	if len(sessionsWithContent) > 0 {
   251→		// New content exists - will generate new checkpoint ID below
   252→		hasNewContent = true
   253→	} else {
   254→		// No new content - check if any session has a LastCheckpointID to reuse
   255→		// This handles the case where user splits Claude's work across multiple commits
   256→		// Reuse if: LastCheckpointID exists AND (FilesTouched is empty OR files overlap)
   257→		// - FilesTouched empty: commits made before session stop, reuse checkpoint
   258→		// - FilesTouched populated: only reuse if files overlap (prevents unrelated commits from reusing)
   259→
   260→		// Get current HEAD to filter sessions
   261→		head, err := repo.Head()
   262→		if err != nil {
   263→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   264→		}
   265→		currentHeadHash := head.Hash().String()
   266→
   267→		// Filter to sessions where BaseCommit matches current HEAD
   268→		// This prevents reusing checkpoint IDs from old sessions
   269→		// Note: BaseCommit is kept current both when new content is condensed (in the
   270→		// condensation process) and when no new content is found (via PostCommit when
   271→		// reusing checkpoint IDs). If none match, we don't add a trailer rather than
   272→		// falling back to old sessions which could have stale checkpoint IDs.
   273→		var currentSessions []*SessionState
   274→		for _, session := range sessions {
   275→			if session.BaseCommit == currentHeadHash {
   276→				currentSessions = append(currentSessions, session)
   277→			}
   278→		}
   279→
   280→		if len(currentSessions) == 0 {
   281→			// No sessions match current HEAD - don't try to reuse checkpoint IDs
   282→			// from old sessions as they may be stale
   283→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: no sessions match current HEAD",
   284→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   285→				slog.String("source", source),
   286→				slog.String("current_head", currentHeadHash[:7]),
   287→				slog.Int("total_sessions", len(sessions)),
   288→			)
   289→			return nil
   290→		}
   291→
   292→		stagedFiles := getStagedFiles(repo)
   293→		for _, session := range currentSessions {
   294→			if !session.LastCheckpointID.IsEmpty() &&
   295→				(len(session.FilesTouched) == 0 || hasOverlappingFiles(stagedFiles, session.FilesTouched)) {
   296→				checkpointID = session.LastCheckpointID
   297→				reusedSession = session
   298→				break
   299→			}
   300→		}
   301→		if checkpointID.IsEmpty() {
   302→			// No new content and no previous checkpoint to reference (or staged files are unrelated)
   303→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: no content to link",
   304→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   305→				slog.String("source", source),
   306→				slog.Int("sessions_found", len(sessions)),
   307→				slog.Int("sessions_with_content", len(sessionsWithContent)),
   308→			)
   309→			return nil
   310→		}
   311→	}
   312→
   313→	// Read current commit message
   314→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // commitMsgFile is provided by git hook
   315→	if err != nil {
   316→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   317→	}
   318→
   319→	message := string(content)
   320→
   321→	// Get or generate checkpoint ID (ParseCheckpoint validates format, so found==true means valid)
   322→	if existingCpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); found {
   323→		// Trailer already exists (e.g., amend) - keep it
   324→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: trailer already exists",
   325→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   326→			slog.String("source", source),
   327→			slog.String("existing_checkpoint_id", existingCpID.String()),
   328→		)
   329→		return nil
   330→	}
   331→
   332→	if hasNewContent {
   333→		// New content: check PendingCheckpointID first (set during previous condensation),
   334→		// otherwise generate a new one. This ensures idempotent IDs across hook invocations.
   335→		for _, state := range sessionsWithContent {
   336→			if state.PendingCheckpointID != "" {
   337→				if cpID, err := id.NewCheckpointID(state.PendingCheckpointID); err == nil {
   338→					checkpointID = cpID
   339→					break
   340→				}
   341→			}
   342→		}
   343→		if checkpointID.IsEmpty() {
   344→			cpID, err := id.Generate()
   345→			if err != nil {
   346→				return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   347→			}
   348→			checkpointID = cpID
   349→		}
   350→	}
   351→	// Otherwise checkpointID is already set to LastCheckpointID from above
   352→
   353→	// Determine agent type and last prompt from session
   354→	agentType := DefaultAgentType // default for backward compatibility
   355→	var lastPrompt string
   356→	if hasNewContent && len(sessionsWithContent) > 0 {
   357→		session := sessionsWithContent[0]
   358→		if session.AgentType != "" {
   359→			agentType = session.AgentType
   360→		}
   361→		lastPrompt = s.getLastPrompt(repo, session)
   362→	} else if reusedSession != nil {
   363→		// Reusing checkpoint from existing session - get agent type and prompt from that session
   364→		if reusedSession.AgentType != "" {
   365→			agentType = reusedSession.AgentType
   366→		}
   367→		lastPrompt = s.getLastPrompt(repo, reusedSession)
   368→	}
   369→
   370→	// Prepare prompt for display: collapse newlines/whitespace, then truncate (rune-safe)
   371→	displayPrompt := stringutil.TruncateRunes(stringutil.CollapseWhitespace(lastPrompt), 80, "...")
   372→
   373→	// Check if we're restoring an existing checkpoint ID (already condensed)
   374→	// vs linking a genuinely new checkpoint. Restoring doesn't need user confirmation
   375→	// since the data is already committed — this handles git commit --amend -m "..."
   376→	// and non-interactive environments (e.g., Claude doing commits).
   377→	isRestoringExisting := false
   378→	if !hasNewContent && reusedSession != nil {
   379→		// Reusing LastCheckpointID from a previous condensation
   380→		isRestoringExisting = true
   381→	} else if hasNewContent {
   382→		for _, state := range sessionsWithContent {
   383→			if state.PendingCheckpointID != "" {
   384→				isRestoringExisting = true
   385→				break
   386→			}
   387→		}
   388→	}
   389→
   390→	// Add trailer differently based on commit source
   391→	switch {
   392→	case source == "message" && !isRestoringExisting:
   393→		// Using -m or -F with genuinely new content: ask user interactively
   394→		// whether to add trailer (comments won't be stripped by git in this mode)
   395→
   396→		// Build context string for interactive prompt
   397→		var promptContext string
   398→		if displayPrompt != "" {
   399→			promptContext = "You have an active " + string(agentType) + " session.\nLast Prompt: " + displayPrompt
   400→		}
   401→
   402→		if !askConfirmTTY("Link this commit to "+string(agentType)+" session context?", promptContext, true) {
   403→			// User declined - don't add trailer
   404→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: user declined trailer",
   405→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   406→				slog.String("source", source),
   407→			)
   408→			return nil
   409→		}
   410→		message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, checkpointID)
   411→	case source == "message":
   412→		// Restoring existing checkpoint ID (amend, split commit, or non-interactive)
   413→		// No confirmation needed — data is already condensed
   414→		message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, checkpointID)
   415→	default:
   416→		// Normal editor flow: add trailer with explanatory comment (will be stripped by git)
   417→		message = addCheckpointTrailerWithComment(message, checkpointID, string(agentType), displayPrompt)
   418→	}
   419→
   420→	logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: trailer added",
   421→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   422→		slog.String("source", source),
   423→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   424→		slog.Bool("has_new_content", hasNewContent),
   425→	)
   426→
   427→	// Write updated message back
   428→	if err := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); err != nil {
   429→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   430→	}
   431→
   432→	return nil
   433→}
   434→
   435→// handleAmendCommitMsg handles the prepare-commit-msg hook for amend operations
   436→// (source="commit"). It preserves existing trailers or restores from PendingCheckpointID.
   437→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) handleAmendCommitMsg(logCtx context.Context, commitMsgFile string) error {
   438→	// Read current commit message
   439→	content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile) //nolint:gosec // commitMsgFile is provided by git hook
   440→	if err != nil {
   441→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   442→	}
   443→
   444→	message := string(content)
   445→
   446→	// If message already has a trailer, keep it unchanged
   447→	if existingCpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(message); found {
   448→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: amend preserves existing trailer",
   449→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   450→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", existingCpID.String()),
   451→		)
   452→		return nil
   453→	}
   454→
   455→	// No trailer in message — check if any session has PendingCheckpointID to restore
   456→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   457→	if err != nil {
   458→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   459→	}
   460→
   461→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   462→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   463→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // No sessions - nothing to restore
   464→	}
   465→
   466→	// Find first session with PendingCheckpointID
   467→	for _, state := range sessions {
   468→		if state.PendingCheckpointID == "" {
   469→			continue
   470→		}
   471→
   472→		cpID, err := id.NewCheckpointID(state.PendingCheckpointID)
   473→		if err != nil {
   474→			continue // Invalid ID, skip
   475→		}
   476→
   477→		// Restore the trailer
   478→		message = addCheckpointTrailer(message, cpID)
   479→		if writeErr := os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(message), 0o600); writeErr != nil {
   480→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   481→		}
   482→
   483→		logging.Info(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: restored trailer on amend from PendingCheckpointID",
   484→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   485→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpID.String()),
   486→			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   487→		)
   488→		return nil
   489→	}
   490→
   491→	// No PendingCheckpointID found - leave message unchanged
   492→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: amend with no pending checkpoint to restore",
   493→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   494→	)
   495→	return nil
   496→}
   497→
   498→// PostCommit is called by the git post-commit hook after a commit is created.
   499→// Uses the session state machine to determine what action to take per session:
   500→//   - ACTIVE → ACTIVE_COMMITTED: defer condensation (agent still working)
   501→//   - IDLE → condense immediately
   502→//   - ACTIVE_COMMITTED → migrate shadow branch (additional commit during same turn)
   503→//   - ENDED → condense if files touched, discard if empty
   504→//
   505→// Shadow branches are only deleted when ALL sessions sharing the branch are non-active.
   506→// During rebase/cherry-pick/revert operations, phase transitions are skipped entirely.
   507→//
   508→//nolint:unparam // error return required by interface but hooks must return nil
   509→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PostCommit() error {
   510→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")
   511→
   512→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   513→	if err != nil {
   514→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   515→	}
   516→
   517→	// Get HEAD commit to check for trailer
   518→	head, err := repo.Head()
   519→	if err != nil {
   520→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   521→	}
   522→
   523→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   524→	if err != nil {
   525→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   526→	}
   527→
   528→	// Check if commit has checkpoint trailer (ParseCheckpoint validates format)
   529→	checkpointID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit.Message)
   530→	if !found {
   531→		// No trailer - user removed it, treat as manual commit
   532→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: no checkpoint trailer",
   533→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   534→		)
   535→		return nil
   536→	}
   537→
   538→	worktreePath, err := GetWorktreePath()
   539→	if err != nil {
   540→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
   541→	}
   542→
   543→	// Find all active sessions for this worktree
   544→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForWorktree(worktreePath)
   545→	if err != nil || len(sessions) == 0 {
   546→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: no active sessions despite trailer",
   547→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   548→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", checkpointID.String()),
   549→		)
   550→		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional: hooks must be silent on failure
   551→	}
   552→
   553→	// Build transition context
   554→	isRebase := isGitSequenceOperation()
   555→	transitionCtx := session.TransitionContext{
   556→		IsRebaseInProgress: isRebase,
   557→	}
   558→
   559→	if isRebase {
   560→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: rebase/sequence in progress, skipping phase transitions",
   561→			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   562→		)
   563→	}
   564→
   565→	// Track shadow branch names and whether they can be deleted
   566→	shadowBranchesToDelete := make(map[string]struct{})
   567→	// Track sessions that are still active AFTER transitions
   568→	activeSessionsOnBranch := make(map[string]bool)
   569→
   570→	newHead := head.Hash().String()
   571→
   572→	// Two-pass processing: condensation first, migration second.
   573→	// This prevents a migration from renaming a shadow branch before another
   574→	// session sharing that branch has had a chance to condense from it.
   575→	type pendingMigration struct {
   576→		state *SessionState
   577→	}
   578→	var pendingMigrations []pendingMigration
   579→
   580→	// Pass 1: Run transitions and dispatch condensation/discard actions.
   581→	// Defer migration actions to pass 2.
   582→	for _, state := range sessions {
   583→		shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   584→
   585→		// Check for new content (needed for TransitionContext and condensation).
   586→		// Fail-open: if content check errors, assume new content exists so we
   587→		// don't silently skip data that should have been condensed.
   588→		hasNew, contentErr := s.sessionHasNewContent(repo, state)
   589→		if contentErr != nil {
   590→			hasNew = true
   591→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: error checking session content, assuming new content",
   592→				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   593→				slog.String("error", contentErr.Error()),
   594→			)
   595→		}
   596→		transitionCtx.HasFilesTouched = len(state.FilesTouched) > 0
   597→
   598→		// Run the state machine transition
   599→		result := session.Transition(state.Phase, session.EventGitCommit, transitionCtx)
   600→		remaining := session.ApplyCommonActions(state, result)
   601→
   602→		// Dispatch strategy-specific actions
   603→		condensed := false
   604→		hasPendingMigration := false
   605→		for _, action := range remaining {
   606→			switch action {
   607→			case session.ActionCondense:
   608→				if hasNew {
   609→					if s.condenseAndUpdateState(logCtx, repo, checkpointID, state, head, shadowBranchName, shadowBranchesToDelete) {
   610→						condensed = true
   611→					}
   612→				} else {
   613→					// No new content to condense — just update BaseCommit
   614→					s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   615→				}
   616→			case session.ActionCondenseIfFilesTouched:
   617→				// The state machine already gates this action on HasFilesTouched,
   618→				// but hasNew is an additional content-level check (transcript has
   619→				// new content beyond what was previously condensed).
   620→				if len(state.FilesTouched) > 0 && hasNew {
   621→					if s.condenseAndUpdateState(logCtx, repo, checkpointID, state, head, shadowBranchName, shadowBranchesToDelete) {
   622→						condensed = true
   623→					}
   624→				}
   625→			case session.ActionDiscardIfNoFiles:
   626→				if len(state.FilesTouched) == 0 {
   627→					logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: skipping empty ended session (no files to condense)",
   628→						slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   629→					)
   630→				}
   631→			case session.ActionMigrateShadowBranch:
   632→				// Deferred to pass 2 so condensation reads the old shadow branch first
   633→				pendingMigrations = append(pendingMigrations, pendingMigration{state: state})
   634→				hasPendingMigration = true
   635→			case session.ActionWarnStaleSession, session.ActionClearEndedAt, session.ActionUpdateLastInteraction:
   636→				// Handled by session.ApplyCommonActions above
   637→			}
   638→		}
   639→
   640→		// If not condensed and no pending migration, update BaseCommit for the new HEAD.
   641→		// Sessions with pending migrations get their BaseCommit updated in pass 2
   642→		// (migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded needs the old BaseCommit to find the branch to rename).
   643→		if !condensed && !hasPendingMigration {
   644→			s.updateBaseCommitIfChanged(logCtx, state, newHead)
   645→		}
   646→
   647→		// Save the updated state
   648→		if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   649→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", err)
   650→		}
   651→
   652→		// Track whether any session on this shadow branch is still active
   653→		if state.Phase.IsActive() {
   654→			activeSessionsOnBranch[shadowBranchName] = true
   655→		}
   656→	}
   657→
   658→	// Pass 2: Run deferred migrations now that all condensations are complete.
   659→	for _, pm := range pendingMigrations {
   660→		if _, migErr := s.migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded(repo, pm.state); migErr != nil {
   661→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "post-commit: shadow branch migration failed",
   662→				slog.String("session_id", pm.state.SessionID),
   663→				slog.String("error", migErr.Error()),
   664→			)
   665→		}
   666→		// Save the migrated state
   667→		if err := s.saveSessionState(pm.state); err != nil {
   668→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to update session state after migration: %v\n", err)
   669→		}
   670→	}
   671→
   672→	// Clean up shadow branches — only delete when ALL sessions on the branch are non-active
   673→	for shadowBranchName := range shadowBranchesToDelete {
   674→		if activeSessionsOnBranch[shadowBranchName] {
   675→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: preserving shadow branch (active session exists)",
   676→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   677→			)
   678→			continue
   679→		}
   680→		if err := deleteShadowBranch(repo, shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   681→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to clean up %s: %v\n", shadowBranchName, err)
   682→		} else {
   683→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Cleaned up shadow branch: %s\n", shadowBranchName)
   684→			logging.Info(logCtx, "shadow branch deleted",
   685→				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   686→				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   687→			)
   688→		}
   689→	}
   690→
   691→	return nil
   692→}

   694→// condenseAndUpdateState runs condensation for a session and updates state afterward.
   695→// Returns true if condensation succeeded.
   696→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) condenseAndUpdateState(
   697→	logCtx context.Context,
   698→	repo *git.Repository,
   699→	checkpointID id.CheckpointID,
   700→	state *SessionState,
   701→	head *plumbing.Reference,
   702→	shadowBranchName string,
   703→	shadowBranchesToDelete map[string]struct{},
   704→) bool {
   705→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(repo, checkpointID, state)
   706→	if err != nil {
   707→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: condensation failed for session %s: %v\n",
   708→			state.SessionID, err)
   709→		return false
   710→	}
   711→
   712→	// Track this shadow branch for cleanup
   713→	shadowBranchesToDelete[shadowBranchName] = struct{}{}
   714→
   715→	// Update session state for the new base commit
   716→	state.BaseCommit = head.Hash().String()
   717→	state.StepCount = 0
   718→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   719→
   720→	// Clear attribution tracking — condensation already used these values
   721→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   722→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   723→
   724→	// Save checkpoint ID so subsequent commits can reuse it
   725→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   726→	// Set PendingCheckpointID for amend trailer restoration
   727→	state.PendingCheckpointID = checkpointID.String()
   728→
   729→	shortID := state.SessionID
   730→	if len(shortID) > 8 {
   731→		shortID = shortID[:8]
   732→	}
   733→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Condensed session %s: %s (%d checkpoints)\n",
   734→		shortID, result.CheckpointID, result.CheckpointsCount)
   735→
   736→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session condensed",
   737→		slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
   738→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   739→		slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
   740→		slog.Int("transcript_lines", result.TotalTranscriptLines),
   741→	)
   742→
   743→	return true
   744→}

   746→// updateBaseCommitIfChanged updates BaseCommit to newHead if it changed.

   757→// filterSessionsWithNewContent returns sessions that have new transcript content
   758→// beyond what was already condensed.
   759→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) filterSessionsWithNewContent(repo *git.Repository, sessions []*SessionState) []*SessionState {
   760→	var result []*SessionState
   761→
   762→	for _, state := range sessions {
   763→		hasNew, err := s.sessionHasNewContent(repo, state)
   764→		if err != nil {
   765→			// On error, include the session (fail open for hooks)
   766→			result = append(result, state)
   767→			continue
   768→		}
   769→		if hasNew {
   770→			result = append(result, state)
   771→		}
   772→	}
   773→
   774→	return result
   775→}

   777→// sessionHasNewContent checks if a session has new transcript content
   778→// beyond what was already condensed.
   779→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) sessionHasNewContent(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
   780→	// Get shadow branch
   781→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   782→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   783→	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   784→	if err != nil {
   785→		// No shadow branch means no Stop has happened since the last condensation.
   786→		// However, the agent may have done work (including commits) without a Stop.
   787→		// Check the live transcript to detect this scenario.
   788→		return s.sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript(repo, state)
   789→	}
   790→
   791→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   792→	if err != nil {
   793→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   794→	}
   795→
   796→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   797→	if err != nil {
   798→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   799→	}
   800→
   801→	// Look for transcript file
   802→	metadataDir := paths.EntireMetadataDir + "/" + state.SessionID
   803→	var transcriptLines int
   804→
   805→	if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   806→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   807→			transcriptLines = countTranscriptLines(content)
   808→		}
   809→	} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   810→		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   811→			transcriptLines = countTranscriptLines(content)
   812→		}
   813→	}
   814→
   815→	// Has new content if there are more lines than already condensed
   816→	return transcriptLines > state.CheckpointTranscriptStart, nil
   817→}
   818→
   819→// countTranscriptLines counts lines in a transcript, matching the counting method used
   820→// in extractSessionData for consistency. This trims trailing empty lines (from final \n
   821→// in JSONL) but includes empty lines in the middle of the file.
   822→func countTranscriptLines(content string) int {
   823→	lines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
   824→	// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
   825→	for len(lines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(lines[len(lines)-1]) == "" {
   826→		lines = lines[:len(lines)-1]
   827→	}
   828→	return len(lines)
   829→}
   830→
   831→// sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript checks if a session has new content
   832→// by examining the live transcript file. This is used when no shadow branch exists
   833→// (i.e., no Stop has happened yet) but the agent may have done work.
   834→//
   835→// Returns true if:
   836→//  1. The transcript has grown since the last condensation, AND
   837→//  2. The new transcript portion contains file modifications, AND
   838→//  3. At least one modified file overlaps with the currently staged files
   839→//
   840→// The overlap check ensures we don't add checkpoint trailers to commits that are
   841→// unrelated to the agent's recent changes.
   842→//
   843→// This handles the scenario where the agent commits mid-session before Stop.
   844→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
   845→	// Need both transcript path and agent type to analyze
   846→	if state.TranscriptPath == "" || state.AgentType == "" {
   847→		return false, nil
   848→	}
   849→
   850→	// Get the agent for transcript analysis
   851→	ag, err := agent.GetByAgentType(state.AgentType)
   852→	if err != nil {
   853→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Unknown agent type, fail gracefully
   854→	}
   855→
   856→	// Cast to TranscriptAnalyzer
   857→	analyzer, ok := ag.(agent.TranscriptAnalyzer)
   858→	if !ok {
   859→		return false, nil // Agent doesn't support transcript analysis
   860→	}
   861→
   862→	// Get current transcript position
   863→	currentPos, err := analyzer.GetTranscriptPosition(state.TranscriptPath)
   864→	if err != nil {
   865→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Error reading transcript, fail gracefully
   866→	}
   867→
   868→	// Check if transcript has grown since last condensation
   869→	if currentPos <= state.CheckpointTranscriptStart {
   870→		return false, nil // No new content
   871→	}
   872→
   873→	// Transcript has grown - check if there are file modifications in the new portion
   874→	modifiedFiles, _, err := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(state.TranscriptPath, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   875→	if err != nil {
   876→		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Error parsing transcript, fail gracefully
   877→	}
   878→
   879→	// No file modifications means no new content to checkpoint
   880→	if len(modifiedFiles) == 0 {
   881→		return false, nil
   882→	}
   883→
   884→	// Check if any modified files overlap with currently staged files
   885→	// This ensures we only add checkpoint trailers to commits that include
   886→	// files the agent actually modified
   887→	stagedFiles := getStagedFiles(repo) // TODO: does it work? Do we have staged files if this is called at post-commit hook ?
   888→	if !hasOverlappingFiles(stagedFiles, modifiedFiles) {
   889→		return false, nil // No overlap - staged files are unrelated to agent's work
   890→	}
   891→
   892→	return true, nil
   893→}
